description: U.S. private AI investment grew to $109.1 billion in 2024.

instances.assertion: U.S. private AI investment grew to $109.1 billion in 2024.
US private AI investment ($109.1 billion) is nearly 12 times higher than China ($9.3 billion) and 24 times higher than the UK ($4.5 billion).
US private AI investment could exceed $100 billion annually.
